scope: The account-free local profile enabled by LABVIZ_LOCAL_ACCESS_KEY.

projectSession.storageMode.temporary-local: A temporary local project, including a bundled example or an import still processing.
projectSession.storageMode.saved-local: A durable project owned by the current Windows user profile.

projectSummary.storageMode.saved-local: A durable project listed in this local profile's history.

legacyReadMapping.saved-cloud: saved-local only when owner_user_id is local-profile; all other owners remain subject to the existing access denial.

migrationPolicy.databaseRows: Existing SQLite rows are interpreted through this API mapping; storage rows and ownership are not rewritten by a read.
migrationPolicy.guestProjects: Guest access tokens, expiry, and temporary retention remain unchanged.
migrationPolicy.accountProjects: Account-owned rows are not re-owned, listed, or exposed to the local profile. The original account flow remains responsible for them.
migrationPolicy.recovery: Back up the stopped application's complete SQLite database and object directory before any explicit migration or repair.
